description.value: Burgoo is a Vancouver-born comfort food bistro founded in 2001, with an old-world countryside aesthetic built around earth tones and natural finishes. The Mount Pleasant outpost on Main Street serves hearty classics like French onion soup, mac and cheese, poutine, and a range of sandwiches and bowls in a cosy neighbourhood setting. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available, making it a practical stop for cyclists needing a proper sit-down meal or a quick pickup.
